card.name: Commas between authors in citations
card.fires_on: Mostly the comma after an author's initials in a reference list, just before the next author's name or 'eds'. Also fires on a few other scattered spots in medical text.

modes.label: Author-list commas
modes.description: A comma after the last initials of an editor or author in a citation, where the next author follows.
modes.example: In: Kliegman RM, Behrman RE<<,>> Jenson HB, Stanton BF, eds

modes.label: Scattered link words
modes.description: Small linking words or number gaps inside clinical or study sentences, such as 'and' between bleeding types or 'per' in rates.
modes.example: treatment with eptifibatide is associated with an increase in major<< and>> minor bleeding at the site of arterial she
